stem: A force of 800 N presses on an area of 4 m². Find the pressure. The first steps are done.
figure:
<svg viewBox="0 0 170 92" width="100%" style="max-width:170px;display:block;margin:.4rem 0" font-family="-apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" aria-label="A downward arrow of 800 newtons pressing on a base of area 4 square metres">
        <line x1="85" y1="8" x2="85" y2="46" stroke="#c8372d" stroke-width="2.5"/>
        <polygon points="85,54 79,42 91,42" fill="#c8372d"/>
        <text x="95" y="30" fill="#c8372d">800 N</text>
        <rect x="20" y="56" width="130" height="22" fill="#e6f4ec" stroke="#1d1d1b" stroke-width="2"/>
        <text x="85" y="72" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1d1d1b">area 4 m²</text>
      </svg>
scaffold: Cover P, so F is left over A. That means 800 ÷ 4. …
hint: Do the division, then write the unit.
working: Cover P, so F is left over A. That means 800 ÷ 4. The pressure is 200 N/m².

misconceptions.message: You multiplied. Covering P leaves F over A, which means divide.
You divided 4 by 800. Force goes on top.
You subtracted. The triangle never adds or subtracts.

stem: The pressure on a floor is 30 N/m² and the area is 5 m². Find the force. The first step is done.
figure:
<svg viewBox="0 0 170 80" width="100%" style="max-width:170px;display:block;margin:.4rem 0" font-family="-apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" aria-label="A floor patch of area 5 square metres with a pressure of 30 newtons per square metre on it">
        <rect x="20" y="30" width="130" height="30" fill="#e6f4ec" stroke="#1d1d1b" stroke-width="2"/>
        <text x="85" y="50" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1d1d1b">area 5 m²</text>
        <text x="85" y="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2b5797">pressure 30 N/m²</text>
        <text x="85" y="76" text-anchor="middle" fill="#c8372d">force = ?</text>
      </svg>
scaffold: Cover F. P and A are left side by side, so multiply. …
hint: Multiply the pressure by the area.
working: Cover F. P and A are left side by side, so multiply. That means 30 × 5. The force is 150 N.

misconceptions.message: You divided 30 by 5. Covering F leaves P beside A, which means multiply.
You divided 5 by 30. Covering F means multiply.
You added. The triangle never adds or subtracts.

stem: A force of 90 N gives a pressure of 15 N/m². Find the area.
figure:
<svg viewBox="0 0 170 92" width="100%" style="max-width:170px;display:block;margin:.4rem 0" font-family="-apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" aria-label="A downward arrow of 90 newtons on a surface of unknown area, with a pressure of 15 newtons per square metre">
        <line x1="85" y1="8" x2="85" y2="46" stroke="#c8372d" stroke-width="2.5"/>
        <polygon points="85,54 79,42 91,42" fill="#c8372d"/>
        <text x="95" y="30" fill="#c8372d">90 N</text>
        <rect x="20" y="56" width="130" height="22" fill="#e6f4ec" stroke="#1d1d1b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 3"/>
        <text x="85" y="72" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1d1d1b">area = ?</text>
        <text x="85" y="90" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2b5797">pressure 15 N/m²</text>
      </svg>
hint: Cover A on the triangle. What is left?
working: Cover A, so F is left over P. That means 90 ÷ 15. The area is 6 m².

misconceptions.message: You multiplied 90 by 15. Covering A leaves F over P, which means divide.
You divided 15 by 90. Force goes on top.
You subtracted. The triangle never adds or subtracts.

stem: A metal block has a mass of 240 g and a volume of 30 cm³. Find its density, in g/cm3.
figure:
<svg viewBox="0 0 170 92" width="100%" style="max-width:170px;display:block;margin:.4rem 0" font-family="-apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" aria-label="A cuboid block labelled mass 240 grams and volume 30 cubic centimetres">
        <polygon points="30,30 110,30 140,14 60,14" fill="#efeeea" stroke="#1d1d1b"/>
        <polygon points="110,30 140,14 140,58 110,74" fill="#d9d7d0" stroke="#1d1d1b"/>
        <rect x="30" y="30" width="80" height="44" fill="#e6f4ec" stroke="#1d1d1b"/>
        <text x="70" y="58" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1d1d1b">240 g</text>
        <text x="85" y="90" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2b5797">volume 30 cm³</text>
      </svg>
hint: This is the same triangle with different letters. Which one goes on top?
working: Density uses the density, mass and volume triangle: M on top, D beside V. Cover D and M is left over V, so 240 ÷ 30 = 8 g/cm³.

misconceptions.message: You multiplied mass by volume. Density is mass ÷ volume.
You divided volume by mass. Mass goes on top.
You added. The triangle never adds or subtracts.

stem: A book presses with 12 N on a face of area 300 cm². Someone covers P, divides 12 ÷ 300 to get 0.04, and writes 0.04 N/m². Which step number did they get wrong?
figure:
<svg viewBox="0 0 170 80" width="100%" style="max-width:170px;display:block;margin:.4rem 0" font-family="-apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" aria-label="A book resting on a face of area 300 square centimetres, pressing down with 12 newtons">
        <line x1="85" y1="6" x2="85" y2="30" stroke="#c8372d" stroke-width="2.5"/>
        <polygon points="85,38 79,26 91,26" fill="#c8372d"/>
        <text x="95" y="22" fill="#c8372d">12 N</text>
        <rect x="30" y="40" width="110" height="18" fill="#efeeea" stroke="#1d1d1b" stroke-width="2"/>
        <text x="85" y="74" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1d1d1b">face area 300 cm²</text>
      </svg>
hint: The number is right. Read the method list again and look at the last step.
working: Step 5 is the unit. The area was given in cm², so the pressure is 0.04 N/cm², not N/m². Everything before that was right.

misconceptions.message: Step 2 covered the right letter, P.
Step 3 read the triangle correctly: F over A means divide.
Step 4 did the division correctly. Look at what they wrote after the number.
